block_selection_rationale: Third block in the backward historical sequence, prioritized ahead of 2024H1 per the user's 2026-10-02 reordering instruction (recent-history-first before resuming the backward sequence). This block's freeze was paused mid-pipeline when the 2026-10-07 observation-freshness bug was discovered during sample inspection; see observation_freshness_methodology below for the fix applied before this freeze.

observation_freshness_methodology.summary: data/weather_state.py's get_observation_state() now rejects any ISD observation older than OBSERVATION_FRESHNESS_THRESHOLD_HOURS=6.0 as a 'current' reading (available=False, current_temp_f/dewpoint/wind/pressure=None), while always preserving latest_observation_time/observation_age for audit. This block is the FIRST to exercise this logic for real (2025H1 and 2024H2 never triggered it -- continuous coverage throughout).
observation_freshness_methodology.threshold_basis: Empirically derived from the worst documented NORMAL ISD reporting gap across 2025H1+2024H2 (~730 station-days): 5 hours (KLGA). 6h gives a ~20% safety margin above that single worst case.
observation_freshness_methodology.regression_against_frozen_blocks: 0 differences found across 4,380 states in 2025H1 and 2024H2 (read-only recomputation, not just estimated) -- the fix is a complete no-op for both, consistent with their max 5h gap never exceeding the 6h threshold. Neither frozen block was modified.
observation_freshness_methodology.twc_investigation: Closed 2026-10-07 without integration -- see docs/decisions.md. TWC's only deep-historical product (History on Demand / gCOD) is a 4km-grid blended/modeled estimate, not a raw station reading, with no documented point-in-time publication timestamp. Missing ISD remains legitimate missing feature data, never substituted.

observations.flagged_day_detail: Flagged days are the KNOWN, documented partial-ISD-coverage gap: real ISD archive content for this block ends ~2025-08-26/27 (confirmed per-station: KNYC/KLGA/KJFK through 2025-08-26, KEWR through 2025-08-25 -- one day earlier). This is NOT an extraction failure; it is a structural archive-currency limitation, identical in kind to the one already documented for the block-selection decision in scripts/backfill_common.py, just reached from the other direction (this block starts within the gap rather than ending at it).
